settings.name: packageManager
settings.description: Package manager used to install dependencies (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun). Empty (default) detects it from the install root's package.json "packageManager" field, else its lockfile, else npm.

settings.name: environment
settings.description: Environment variables set in the test containers, as KEY=VALUE (e.g. ["DEBUG=pw:api"]).

settings.name: localhostProxy
settings.description: Proxy localhost:<port> to the bound service via socat, and set PLAYWRIGHT_LOCALHOST_BASE_URL. For tests that need a secure context (service workers, WebCrypto) — those require a localhost or HTTPS origin. Requires an apt-based base image (the default images qualify).

settings.name: args
settings.description: Extra arguments passed to every `playwright test` invocation (e.g. ["--project", "chromium"]).

settings.name: reporters
settings.description: Playwright reporters every run uses, in place of the config's: built-in names, paths relative to the project, or installed packages (e.g. ["list", "junit"]). The telemetry reporter is always added. The flag can't carry reporter options; built-in reporters read theirs from environment variables such as PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT_FILE (see `environment`). When none of them prints to the terminal, Playwright adds the dot reporter.

Run arbitrary Gradle tasks and return the resulting container for further customization or artifact/report extraction. Task names are passed verbatim.

Build and verify signed AABs. Gradle must read ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE, ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS, and ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD. Keystore bytes and passwords use Dagger secrets. Tasks always rerun with the Gradle build cache disabled so previous signed outputs cannot be reused. This function builds artifacts only; it does not upload or publish them.
Run all JVM unit tests directly, without collection discovery. The test check is exposed through tests so selecting collection items does not also run the entire suite.

settings.name: baseImageAddress
settings.description: The Swift toolchain image.

settings.name: base
settings.description: Optional container with Swift and additional system dependencies installed.

settings.name: buildFlags
settings.description: Arguments appended to swift build, for example ["--configuration", "release"].

settings.name: testFlags
settings.description: Arguments appended to swift test, for example ["--filter", "SignalsTests"].

settings.name: environment
settings.description: Environment variables for builds and tests, as KEY=VALUE.

settings.name: includeExtraFiles
settings.description: Workspace-root include patterns mounted alongside each package at their original relative paths. Use for local package dependencies and shared test fixtures.

settings.name: packageInclude
settings.description: Workspace-relative package directory paths or globs to discover. Empty includes all packages.

settings.name: packageExclude
settings.description: Workspace-relative package directory paths or globs to exclude from discovery. Exclusions win.

entries.description: Compile this package for Linux with swift build.
descriptions: Build the selected packages.

entries.description: Run this test, or all cases of this parameterized test function.
descriptions: Run selected tests together. A narrowed selection overrides testFlags' filter or specifier; skip flags still apply. An empty selection runs nothing.

entries.description: A Swift container with the package mounted and its working directory set.
Package source, excluding host build products and gitignored files.
Swift packages visible from the working directory, keyed by workspace-relative root.
Discover test identifiers with swift test list. This compiles the test targets. Parameterized Swift Testing functions are one item, running all their cases.
Select a package by a path relative to the working directory.
Run this package's XCTest and Swift Testing tests with swift test.
Run the selected packages' tests.

modules.name: maven
modules.description: Run tests and builds with Maven

settings.name: mavenVersion
settings.description: Maven release used when there is no wrapper. Ignored with base.

settings.name: javaVersion
settings.description: Eclipse Temurin JDK version for the default image. Ignored with base.

settings.name: base
settings.description: Custom container with a JDK, sh, and Maven (or wrapper prerequisites).

settings.name: useWrapper
settings.description: Use mvnw when present at the project root; otherwise use mvn.

settings.name: args
settings.description: Arguments for every invocation, e.g. profiles, properties, or -pl/-am.

settings.name: roots
settings.description: Explicit workspace-relative reactor roots. Empty discovers outermost POMs. Set this for independently built projects nested beneath another POM.

settings.name: settings
settings.description: Secret settings.xml, for private repositories, mirrors, and deployment.

settings.name: toolchains
settings.description: Optional toolchains.xml. JDK paths must exist in the base container.

settings.name: cacheKey
settings.description: Cache namespace override. Empty isolates caches by workspace and project. This holds the local repository and wrapper distributions, never settings.

settings.name: testSourceDirectory
settings.description: Java test source directory relative to each POM, used only for class discovery. Maven's own source and plugin configuration still controls compilation.

settings.name: testIncludes
settings.description: Class discovery patterns relative to testSourceDirectory. These are Surefire's conventional Java filenames; discovery does not evaluate the effective POM.

settings.name: testExcludes
settings.description: Patterns excluded from test-class discovery, relative to testSourceDirectory.

entries.description: Run through verify: unit tests, packaging, integration tests, and quality gates.
descriptions: Verify every selected reactor and report every failing project.

entries.description: Compile production sources and return the resulting container.
Prepared container for customization, services, and debugging. Caches are locked because separate Maven processes must not write one repository at once.

Verify and install into this project's cached local repository. Return the container to continue work in the same repository. Always execute the install so a cached result cannot hide an evicted cache volume's missing artifacts.
Run unit tests. Full verification, including integration tests, uses verify.
Run this class, building reactor dependencies as needed.
descriptions: Run all selected classes in one Maven reactor invocation. Dependencies still build in reactor order; unselected classes do not run. An empty subset is a no-op.

entries.description: Package the reactor, running unit tests by default, and return its target trees, preserving module paths. Use run for custom build directories.

Return Surefire/Failsafe reports with reactor-relative paths, including failed tests. Test failures are ignored only here so reports can be exported; use the verify check for the pass/fail verdict. Compilation and plugin errors still fail.
Workspace source, preserving sibling modules, relative parents, .mvn config, resources, and build scripts. Host targets and dependency caches are excluded.

Reactor roots in view, keyed by workspace-relative directory. Discovery uses outermost pom.xml directories so reactor members are not built twice. From inside a reactor, that whole reactor remains selected.

Java unit-test class candidates, keyed by reactor-relative module directory and fully qualified class name, e.g. app/example.AppTest. Listing runs no Maven command. Names are inferred from paths beneath testSourceDirectory. Class operations are explicit, leaving verify as the only automatic check.
A specific reactor root, relative to the workspace root.
Verify and deploy using the POM's distributionManagement and secret settings. Explicit only: never a check. Always executes, even for unchanged source.
Run goals or lifecycle phases. Return the container for chaining or extracting custom outputs. Set fresh for snapshot refreshes or commands with side effects.
Fully qualified Java class name.
Module directory relative to the reactor root.
